info.description: Open-source HTTP API for ThingIndex covering auth, document cataloging, provider configuration, monitoring, and grounded chat.
info.title: Thing-Index API

post.description: Send a reset password link to the user's email
Authenticate user with email and password and return a JWT token
Create a new user account and return a JWT token
Reset the user's password using a reset token

get.description: List saved chat conversations for the authenticated user inside one collection.

post.description: Create a persisted chat conversation scoped to one collection before starting the grounded response stream.

get.description: Fetch one persisted chat conversation and the grounded messages already stored for it.

delete.description: Delete one persisted chat conversation and its grounded message history.

post.description: Start a grounded chat response for one persisted conversation and stream stage, source, delta, done, and error events over SSE.

get.description: Query document audit events with operational filters, summary and cursor pagination.

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous audit page
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Search over title, detail, origin and request correlation
parameters.name: q

get.description: Return the operational monitoring summary for the authenticated user, including queue counters, failure buckets and LLM telemetry aggregates.
Returns the controlled corpus, exact-match benchmark metrics, and interpretation guidance for the current relational indexing baseline.
Returns the current primary use case, scope, explicit non-goals, and academic/reference artifacts for the main ThingIndex runtime.
Returns the current support classification for provider integrations, including support tier, transport mode, setup hints and operational notes.

parameters.description: Optional provider family filter. Supported values: STORAGE, LLM.
parameters.name: family

get.description: Return the latest synced pricing snapshot for the authenticated user across all configured pricing sources.
Return the recent price history captured from synced pricing sources for the authenticated user.

parameters.description: Maximum number of history rows to return
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Return the saved pricing source URLs and the latest sync status for the authenticated user.

post.description: Register or update an official pricing source URL so the pricing worker can sync model prices for the authenticated user.

get.description: Query provider audit events with operational filters, summary and cursor pagination.

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous audit page
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Search over provider type, detail, origin and request correlation
parameters.name: q

post.description: Tries to discover available models for the selected LLM provider, using live discovery and cached fallbacks when applicable.

get.description: Returns the currently active storage, indexing, and chat providers for the authenticated user.

post.description: Validates the configured provider credentials and returns a readiness report with connectivity checks and optional model discovery details.
